attributes.fresh: Whether all required source observations satisfy the configured age and timestamp-coherence rules.
attributes.positive_direction: The canonical direction represented by a positive state value.
attributes.reason: The stable machine-readable explanation for the selected source or current unavailability.
attributes.sources: The contributing entity IDs, raw values, raw units and observation timestamps.
attributes.valid: Whether the normalized sample passed source, unit, sign and topology validation.

attributes.additional_boost_rate_per_kwh: Configured additional Super Export top-up rate.
attributes.boosted_bonus_revenue: Revenue contributed by the additional boost only.
attributes.boosted_rate_export_kwh: Export energy eligible for the additional boost.
attributes.boosted_window_export_kwh: All measured export energy in the boost-eligible window.
attributes.offpeak_export_revenue: Revenue calculated at the off-peak base feed-in rate.
attributes.offpeak_rate_export_kwh: Measured export energy assigned to the off-peak base rate.
attributes.standard_export_revenue: Revenue calculated at the peak base feed-in rate.
attributes.standard_rate_export_kwh: Measured export energy assigned to the peak base rate.
attributes.standard_window_export_kwh: Measured export energy in the configured peak feed-in window.

attributes.assumed_zerohero_credit: ZEROHERO credit assumed by the optimistic forecast.
attributes.export_realisation_percent: Learned fraction of remaining planned export assumed by the forecast.
attributes.forecast_additional_export_revenue: Forecast revenue from the assumed remaining export.
attributes.forecast_remaining_export_kwh: Remaining planned export energy included in the forecast.
attributes.gross_cost: Calculated gross import and supply cost so far.
attributes.learned_cost_bias: Bounded learned correction applied only to the forecast.
attributes.measured_export_revenue: Calculated revenue from measured export so far.
attributes.measured_net_cost: Calculated factual net cost so far.
attributes.measured_zerohero_credit: ZEROHERO credit already evidenced in today's ledger.
attributes.raw_optimistic_forecast: Optimistic forecast before the bounded learned cost bias.

attributes.actual_cost: Retailer-reported actual cost for the matched completed day.
attributes.export_realisation_ratio: Realised export divided by the retained planned export.
attributes.forecast_cost: Frozen calibrated forecast for the matched day.
attributes.forecast_error: Actual cost minus frozen forecast cost.
attributes.forecast_feedback_applied: Whether this result has updated the bounded forecast calibration.
attributes.planned_export_kwh: Export energy planned in the frozen matched-day forecast.
attributes.realised_export_kwh: Measured export energy for the matched day.
attributes.result_date: Local calendar date shared by the forecast and retailer result.
attributes.zerohero_status: Retailer-reported ZEROHERO result for the matched day.

attributes.all_people_away_for_hours: Elapsed time for which all discovered people have remained away.
attributes.people_home: Number of discovered person entities currently classified home.
attributes.person_entities_found: Number of person entities included in occupancy evaluation.
attributes.reason: Stable machine-readable explanation for the occupancy result.
attributes.selected_mode: Configured automatic, forced-home or forced-away occupancy policy.
